summary: The gpt camp somehow parked themselves at the top with $142k while their best contribution was a big nothingburger labeled "no valid response today," which is less trading and more showing up empty-handed. The claude camp took the crown for total collapse, bleeding out to $54k after their model got the deprecation death sentence and turned in an unparseable mess that belongs in the trash. Meanwhile the gemini and llama camps both got smacked for trying to short in long-only games like complete amateurs, and the headline camp joined the gpt camp in serving up 404s instead of actual trades, leaving everyone wondering who even bothered to read the rules.
